title: 第12章 技术是什么第11章 参与历史
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
“法伦，你在我的地盘里，玩得挺开心的啊——”
鉴定室的门缓缓合上。
莱妮丝站在门口，没有立刻进来。
她先扫了一眼室内。
长桌上堆满了高阶材料。
几块空间晶石已经失去光泽，旁边散着被切开的魔兽核心。
地上扔着数张报废的结构草图。
墨迹凌乱，有几处甚至被火烧穿。
工作台中央，一张刚处理完的卷轴还在冒着热气。
法伦手边，则放着一套全新的符文回路。
至于费尔明，他已经完全僵住了。
他看看法伦，又看看门口的莱妮丝，脑中一片空白。
赫本商行的大小姐。
阿瓦隆学院戏剧社的社长。
费尔明在学院里见过莱妮丝，也有幸看过她的排位赛。
只是他怎么也没想到，对方会在这个时间，出现在佛罗伦萨分行的地下鉴定室里。
下一刻，他像是终于反应过来。
“大小姐？”
莱妮丝看了他一眼，没说话。
法伦倒是很平静。

“我还真没想到，你会现在出现在佛罗伦萨。”
莱妮丝迈步走进鉴定室。
“你在我的分行里连续用了六个小时的最高级鉴定室和工作台，烧掉的材料足够买下外面半条街。”
她走到桌边，拿起一块已经报废的空间晶石。
“现在倒嫌我来得巧？”
法伦看了一眼晶石。
“账算得这么快？”
“赫本家的人，可以不懂魔法，但不能不会算账。”
莱妮丝随手将晶石放回桌上。
她的语气不重，甚至还带着一点笑意。
可站在门外的马尔科已经满头冷汗。
莱妮丝没有回头。
“马尔科。”
“大小姐。”
“今晚地下鉴定区的使用记录，暂时封存。”
“是。”
“外面的人先撤走。鉴定师也一样。没有我的允许，谁都不准再进来。”
马尔科迟疑了一瞬。
“可这里的安全……”
“有问题，我负责。”

“明白了。”
脚步声很快远去。
房门关闭，隔音符文重新亮起。
鉴定室内只剩下三个人。
content_en:
"Fallon, you are having a lot of fun in my territory——"
The door to the identification room slowly closed.
Lenis stood at the door and did not come in immediately.
She glanced around the room first.
The long table is piled with high-end materials.
Several pieces of space crystal have lost their luster, and the cores of World of Warcraft that have been sliced ​​are scattered next to them.
Several scrapped structural sketches were thrown on the ground.
The ink marks were messy, and some were even burned through by fire.
In the center of the workbench, a scroll that had just been processed was still steaming.
Fallon has a brand new set of rune circuits at hand.
As for Fermin, he was completely frozen.
He looked at Fallon and then at Lenis at the door, his mind went blank.
The eldest lady of Hepburn Firm.
President of the Avalon College Drama Club.
Fermin had met Lenis in the academy and had the opportunity to watch her qualifying matches.
But he never expected that the other party would appear in the underground appraisal room of the Florence branch at this time.
The next moment, he seemed to finally react.
"Miss?"
Lenis glanced at him but said nothing.
Fallon was calm.
"I really didn't expect you to show up in Florence now."
Lenis stepped into the appraisal room.
"You used the top-grade appraisal room and workbench in my branch for six hours straight, and burned enough materials to buy half the street outside."
She walked to the table and picked up a scrapped space crystal.
"Do you think I came by chance now?"
Fallon glanced at the crystal.
"Settling the accounts so quickly?"
"People in the Hepburn family may not know magic, but they must not know how to settle accounts."
Lenis put the crystal back on the table casually.
Her tone was not serious, and she even had a little smile.
But Marco standing outside the door was already covered in cold sweat.
Lenis did not look back.
"Marco."
"Miss."
"The usage records of the underground identification area tonight are temporarily sealed."
"Yes."
"People outside should evacuate first. The same goes for the appraisers. No one is allowed to come in again without my permission."
Marco hesitated for a moment.
"But the safety here..."
"If there is a problem, I will take responsibility."
"Got it."
The footsteps quickly faded away.
The door is closed and the insulation signs light up again.
There were only three people left in the appraisal room.
